messages:
Samir Gupta: Heads up	found a mismatch in the Go quickstart. README uses `REDWOOD_KEY` in the curl example, but the Go sample expects `os.Getenv(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\")`. New users hit 401s when they copy/paste.

Elena Morales: Oh no, I ran into that when helping a new hire yesterday. Also the Go snippet imports `github.com/redwoodai/sdk` but the module was renamed to `github.com/redwoodai/inference` last quarter. Build fails = bad first impression.

Samir Gupta: Oof. There's also a manual retry wrapper around the request in the sample which calls the same action twice on non-idempotent endpoints. SDK now handles retries for idempotent ops so that wrapper is dangerous.

kevin-ci: I opened a quick PR to fix all three: env var parity to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, update import path, and remove the retry wrapper from the sample app. Also added a small note on token scopes (generation vs embeddings) because people keep pasting the wrong key.

Elena Morales: Can you add a one-line example showing how to disable SDK retries if someone has their own logic? e.g., `client := inference.NewClient(apiKey, inference.WithRetries(0))`. Saves a follow-up question.

kevin-ci: Yup will add that. Also adding a tiny Go example showing context usage and a short comment about async/goroutine safety for the client.

Samir Gupta: Please update the curl header example to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` too so everything matches. And add a short "If you see 403, check token scopes" callout.

kevin-ci: Draft snippet to push:
```go
package main
import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "github.com/redwoodai/inference"
)
func main() {
    ctx := context.Background()
    client := inference.NewClient(os.Getenv(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\")) // default: retries enabled
    resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, "Write a short limerick about servers")
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```

kevin-ci: PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/3155 includes import fix, env var parity, retry removal, and scope callout. Requesting docs review.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Label `DX` added and reviewers requested: @elena, @samir.

Elena Morales: Reviewed, left a tiny nit on wording for the scope callout.

Samir Gupta: Approved. Thanks for the quick turn.
